sentences.text: Life After Death is the second and final studio album by American rapper The Notorious B.I.G. , released on March 25 , 1997 , on Bad Boy Records .	Bad Boy	Bad Boy Records	studio album	studio album	Bad Boy Records	Bad Boy Records
A double album , it was released posthumously following his death on March 9 , 1997 .	double album	double album

It features collaborations with guest artists such as 112 , Jay-Z , Lil ' Kim , Mase , Bone Thugs-n-Harmony , Too $ hort , Angela Winbush , D.M.C. of Run-D.M.C .	112	112 (band)	Jay-Z	Jay-Z	Mase	Mase	Bone Thugs-n-Harmony	Bone Thugs-n-Harmony	Angela Winbush	Angela Winbush
, R. Kelly , The LOX and Puff Daddy .	R. Kelly	R. Kelly	The LOX	The LOX	Puff Daddy	Puff Daddy
Life After Death exhibits The Notorious B.I.G. further delving into the mafioso rap subgenre .	mafioso rap	mafioso rap
The album is a sequel to his first album , Ready to Die , and picks up where the last song , `` Suicidal Thoughts '' , ends .	Ready to Die	Ready to Die

The album was nominated for three Grammy Awards in 1998 including Best Rap Album , Best Rap Solo Performance for its first single `` Hypnotize '' , and Best Rap Performance by a Duo or Group for its second single `` Mo Money Mo Problems '' .
